annotations.title: What each app's data can prove

description: Per app and ad channel (Apple Ads, Meta, …), over the last 30 days of synced data: what Apptiller can judge the channel's campaigns by (paying subscribers, the MMP's purchase or trial event counts, Meta's own conversion counts, installs, or only the network's own claims), the source that rests on, and what is missing, with how to fix it in tools the user already has. Also each connected account's facts in its layer (installs, MMP revenue and purchase events, customers and tags, spend). Reads synced data only; asks nothing of the app.
name: data_coverage
title: What each app's data can prove
